newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor down on profit-taking, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor down on profit-taking, volume thin.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery dropped by 2/3 rupees at 1,152/1,153 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative offerings on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Technically market turned overbought after recent gains and profit-taking triggered correction," one broker said.
"Volume remained thin but looking at the slow progress of the monsoon in the second round prices may bounce back again," he added.
Groundnut oil lifted further by 2 rupees at 378/379 rupees per 10 kg amid limited supplies and renewed seasonal support.
In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil fell by 5 rupees at 600/605 rupees per 15 kg on profit-taking at the higher level.

In Bombay imported palm-oil slid by 3 rupees at 255/256 rupees per 10 kg on unloading by local importers following reports of losses in the world market. Traders reported arrivals of about 5,000 tonnes of palm-oil at Bombay port. They are expecting more arrivals next week.
